title: Mobile persona simulation and staging preview gate
goal: Exercise every shipped iOS and Android journey against a matching isolated staging release and retain cross-actor evidence

in: Build a fail-closed mobile preview simulation gate for shipped iOS and Android journeys.
Record preview build IDs, staging API target and release SHA, actor references, and per-platform evidence.
out: Production mobile release or store submission.
Marking a route as shipped based solely on source files.

acceptance_criteria: iOS and Android preview builds refuse non-isolated or mismatched staging targets.
Every shipped mobile action and web/API handoff has an actor-level result and retained evidence.
Both platforms cover authorization, empty/error/retry, accessibility, and persistence scenarios where applicable.
No mobile result is claimed from local contract validation alone.

commands: Preview build and actor run against recorded staging SHA
evidence: Local: npm run simulation:test in apps/mobile passed (7 tests).
No EAS build, device run, or hosted backend request was made.

2026-09-22 local release/QA gate wave: 13 deployment/topology/evidence/workflow Node tests, 7 actor-provisioner tests, 7 mobile gate tests, launch fixture contract, public-surface check, focused ESLint, and workflow YAML parse passed. Hosted deployment, certification, and simulation were not run.
2026-09-22 dependency check: QA-005 operator packet prepared; all campaign variables absent and no hosted actors provisioned. No mobile journey credit.
2026-09-22 thin pilot preflight: npm run simulation:test in apps/mobile passed (7 tests); no preview build, device observation, or mobile pass was claimed.

2026-09-22 QA actor operator pass: docs/audits/flow-notes/qa005-actor-provisioning-packet-2026-09-22.md records all 11 absent QA_CAMPAIGN inputs, twelve manifest actor keys, exact hosted gate dependencies, and first web pilot order. Read-only GET health checks returned 200 but no release/deployment/database/Stripe identity headers; both CSPs advertised the same Supabase origin. No hosted Auth, database, payment, device, or UI action.
2026-09-22 final QA check: npm --prefix apps/mobile run simulation:test passed 7/7; mobile typecheck passed. No EAS preview build, device observation, or mobile coverage pass.
